policy.subject_unit: Curated program family; all original CN source variants retained. Different interfaces/types remain explicit implementation profiles, not asserted equivalent.
policy.implementation_identity: C token fingerprint of selected function module plus inline layout blocks; whitespace/comments excluded and locally defined function names normalized. Not a proof of semantic equivalence; preprocessing and local-variable alpha equivalence are not inferred.
policy.client_drivers: Historical main is retained and fingerprinted separately for function modules. runtime-extras and runway keep main within implementation scope.
policy.specification_identity: Normalized CN annotation text; not a proof of logical equivalence. Missing postcondition, weak valid contract and false contract are different roles.
policy.minimum_design: At least one correct case, three false-spec cases and three bad-implementation cases per family. Original variants are additional; multiple correct implementations and valid weak specs are retained, not forced into negative slots.
policy.legacy: 76 source rows and 532 planned slots are historical provenance counts, not 76 independent programs. Existing artifacts and raw timings are not deleted or rewritten.
policy.qcp_pairing: Constructed paired cases preserve their existing validation. Original CN contract alignment is separate; corrected QCP baselines never silently replace original negative/weak contracts.
policy.split: All family variants and duplicate aliases must remain in the same experimental split.
